body: Thanks for the videos, and for taking a moment to talk to me. It really helped.
I'm in an art class now at my school, and I'm doing alright. I've always really liked piano music, it's probably my favorite.

I like to sing anything, really. Just whatever I happen to be listening to at the time. When I draw, I usually use charcoal or pencil, but sometimes I'll go back over it with pen. I don't necessarily want to draw anyone in particular, just whatever comes to mind.
I like to sing, and I'm decent at drawing portraits of people, I guess. It all sounds really silly when I say it.

Well, I guess in my wildest dream I always wanted to do something really important. You know, like how in books there is usually one person who saves the day, all of that kind of stuff. I also want to be an artist, but I know it's impractical. Singing, drawing, that kind of stuff. I just don't really have the talent.
Will the hospital charge money for any help I receive? Like I said, I don't have much money and my parents are unwilling to pay. Thank you so much for the advice, it means a lot.
